title: gc status --json result
description: One JSONL record describing city identity, controller state, health, agents, rigs, and summary counts.

_cache_age_s.description: Present only on output read from the city's API (supervisor or controller); absent on locally built output. Age in seconds of the cached state the server answered from: its bead cache's snapshot age, or the served response's own age when greater (a stale response served while it refreshes); 0 when the server reported no age.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this command output.

running.description: Whether the city controller appears to be running.
Whether the city is considered running.

usable.description: Whether agents and software can use the city.

degraded.description: Whether any degraded signal was observed.

beads.description: Bead store selection and native-store eligibility diagnostics.

native_store_eligible.description: Whether the native Dolt-backed store passed preflight gates.

preflight_gate.description: Preflight gate that prevented native-store selection, when any.

preflight_reason.description: Human-readable native-store fallback reason, when any.

proxied.description: The proxied-native read lane's account of the bead store open this output was read through: the CLI's own open on locally built output, the serving controller's on output read from the city's API. Present only when GC_BEADS_PROXIED_NATIVE is on for a proxied-server scope.

endpoint.description: The proxy generation the open pinned; empty when admission refused before resolving one.

evidence.description: How the proxy's liveness was established.

cursors.description: The database's two migration cursors as the probe read them.

verdict.description: Why the lane refused; absent when it did not.

detail.description: An unexpected opener failure's text, or the hashes of a head_moved incident.

demoted.description: True when a handle that served natively has dropped to the bd leaf.

conditional_writes.description: Present only on output read from the city's API; absent on locally built output. The serving controller's boot-latched conditional-writes (CAS) rollout state and per-store capability verdicts, as GET /v0/city/{cityName}/status reports them.

origin.description: Where the latched mode came from.

effective.description: Aggregate verdict: off (gate off), active (every store capable), degraded (auto with at least one incapable store), fail_closed (require with at least one incapable store; fenced writes on it refuse), pending_restart (on-disk config drifted from the latched mode).

stores.description: Per-store verdicts, one row per controller-owned store.

kind.description: Store kind in the degraded-event wire vocabulary (bd, native, caching, mem, file).

probe.description: Memoized capability-probe verdict; unprobed means no fenced write has exercised this store yet.

latch.description: Runtime unsupported latch: incapable after the store rejected a real fenced write; cleared only by restart.

capable.description: What the write path uses today: false only on a definitive incapable verdict.

reason.description: Incapable cause, verbatim from the probe or latch.

notices.description: Retained rollout notices (env overrides, drift, invalid spellings).

flag_key.description: Rollout gate key the notice is about.

config_value.description: Raw config spelling; empty when unset.

message.description: Human-readable line carrying the gate and the outcome.

agents.description: Configured agents visible to the city.

rigs.description: Registered rigs visible to the city.

default_sling_targets.description: Configured default sling targets the rig picks among at random, when set.

unknown_agents.description: How many of total_agents the runtime probe never answered for. Omitted unless the result is partial. running_agents counts only agents observed running, so during a partial result total_agents minus running_agents is not a count of stopped agents, and this is the part of that difference nothing was learned about.

store_health.description: Dolt bead store health. Present when a running controller serves the status or reports itself running; absent otherwise.

path.description: On-disk path of the Dolt store.

size_bytes.description: Total bytes of the store directory.

live_rows.description: Retained bead rows, open and closed. Meaningless when live_rows_unknown is true.

live_rows_unknown.description: True when the row count failed or timed out; live_rows, ratio_mb_per_row and warning then carry no meaning. Absent when the count is real.

threshold_mb_per_row.description: Ratio threshold above which warning trips.

last_gc_at.description: RFC3339 time of the last maintenance run, when one is recorded.

last_gc_status.description: Outcome of the last maintenance run (success or failed), when one is recorded.

partial.description: True when the result is intentionally degraded because one or more live status probes timed out or otherwise failed.

partial_errors.description: Human-readable diagnostics explaining omitted or unknown portions of a partial status result.
